verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships an official MCP server (GitHub repo pagerduty-mcp-server, developer docs page) providing tools to interact with PagerDuty directly from MCP-enabled clients, and a runtime probe confirms a live hosted remote MCP endpoint at mcp.pagerduty.com requiring proper auth, corroborating the docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on review of the MCP server in production use beyond the vendor's own runtime probe.
